summary: Keep Cloudflare DNS records pointed at a changing public IP address with a small, independent updater container.
overview: Cloudflare DDNS by favonia detects your public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and updates the matching A and AAAA records through the Cloudflare API. You list the domains to manage and supply a scoped API token; the updater finds the zones, preserves existing proxy settings, and rechecks on a schedule. It is an independent open-source project rather than a Cloudflare product, and it is usually run as a hardened Docker container next to a reverse proxy.
